title_as_printed: Densities of CO2-saturated and non-CO2 NaCl solutions (3.42 mol kg-1) at 303 K and 333 K
pressure_note: Pressure held at the stated value by a syringe pump during CO2 saturation; transducer uncertainty 0.25% full scale. For the CO2-free brine the system was pressurised with a hand pump. Whether the pressure is CO2 partial or total is not stated (pure CO2 over brine, so total).
volume_basis_evidence: density reported in g/cm3 of the solution

composition.note: set per block by label rows; molalities from the paper's Table 4

skip_rows.reason: block label row (solution code and temperature)

notes: Four side-by-side blocks printed in landscape; stacked left to right, one label row per block. Blocks S2/S4 (CO2-saturated) are property rho_gas_loaded with gas co2; S1/S3 CO2-free. Block-set property, gas, T and composition override the table-level defaults. Blank uncertainty cells are empty.
